conversation.speaker: ai_agent

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Those are incredibly complex and profound fields. What do you find most compelling about them?

conversation.message: That makes a lot of sense. What do you think is the biggest challenge in these fields today?

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
